summary: Bounded, resumable ASCET database search commands for component candidates, element candidates, and mixed occurrences.
routingHints: Use AscetSearchComponents for paged candidate discovery across folders.
Use AscetResolveComponent only when strict uniqueness is required; ambiguous queries return unresolved instead of selecting the first match.
Use AscetSearchElements after narrowing scope, then confirm candidates with read commands.
Use AscetWarmSearchIndex to build the in-memory element lookup before repeated quick-search queries.
Use AscetSearchOccurrences for a bounded mixed component and element occurrence view.
